evidence: From worktree `/home/andrewyin/orchestra/.worktrees/cross-harness-install`: `python3 -m pytest tests/test_cli_surface.py -q` → 19 passed; `python3 -m pytest tests/test_skill_portability.py -q -k runtime` → 11 passed, 25 deselected; full `tests/test_skill_portability.py` → 36 passed; `python3 scripts/build_skills.py --check` → generated files match; affected set (`test_orchestra_commands`, `test_skill_evidence_boundary`, `test_phase_reviewer`, `test_tiered_verification -k "not this_repo_suite_policy"`, both acceptance files) → 90 passed, 1 deselected; `tests/test_cli_packaging.py` → 4 passed. Broad non-dashboard run: 616 passed, 5 failed — all pre-existing/environmental: 2 read `.artifacts/project-design.json` (excluded from this worktree), 3 read `AGENTS.md`/`CLAUDE.md` which do not exist in the repo.
observations: Added `orchestra review-brief` (loads reviewer-allowed record kinds via `adaptive-artifacts list --full`, plus `git diff base..head`), `orchestra suite policy|start|poll|collect|record`, and `orchestra store path|run|ensure`. Rewrote `skills/execute-phase/SKILL.md` and `shared/ensure-store.md` to name commands, not modules, and regenerated references. Removed `dashboard.artifact_store` from `orchestra/suite.py` in favour of `orchestra.aa_resolve`, so the installed CLI can load suite policy. Added `tests/test_cli_surface.py` (19 tests) and a `runtime` selector in `tests/test_skill_portability.py`. One out-of-territory edit: `tests/test_tiered_verification.py` asserted `orchestra.suite` in the skill, which the new portability rule forbids; relaxed it to `orchestra suite`.
root_cause: Skills named importable APIs (`orchestra.reviewer.*`, `orchestra.suite.*`, `orchestra.aa`) with no CLI equivalent, so an installed CLI had no documented invocation from a work repo; suite policy also depended on the unpackaged `dashboard` module.
verdict: pass
metrics: 15 files changed, +1019/−84; 3 new command groups (review-brief, suite, store) with 9 subcommands; 19 new CLI-surface tests; 4 new runtime portability assertions/selectors.
claim: A work repo can run the reviewer brief, contracted phase suite, and store-bound adaptive-artifacts calls using `orchestra` alone, with no module imports or checkout paths in skills.
